idea-plugin.name: OpenAPI SpecTacular
idea-plugin.description:
Generate realistic example objects from your OpenAPI specifications.

Features:

  • Right-click over the OpenApi Specification file
  • Parse OpenAPI 3.x and Swagger 2.x specifications (YAML and JSON)
  • Select the number of examples to generate per schema
  • Preview the generated output and copy it to the clipboard
  • Export examples as JSON or YAML, per schema or combined
  • Respects schema constraints (enums, min/max, lengths, oneOf/anyOf/allOf)
  • Validate OpenAPI specs and see parser errors and warnings
  • Configurable defaults in Settings | Tools | OpenAPI SpecTacular
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.1.0

  • Export examples as JSON or YAML, per schema or combined into a single file
  • Preview the generated output in the dialog and copy it to the clipboard
  • New action: Validate OpenAPI Specification, reporting parser errors and warnings
  • New settings page with configurable defaults in Settings | Tools | OpenAPI SpecTacular
  • Respect schema constraints: enums, min/max bounds, string lengths, oneOf/anyOf/allOf
  • Updated build tooling and dependencies

1.0.0

  • Initial release: generate realistic JSON examples from OpenAPI 3.x and Swagger 2.x specs
